actual: AIstock production MCP servers are explicitly required to connect to production backend port 8001. Project .mcp.json and Codex global MCP env use 8001, but backend/mcp/gateway.py, scripts/aistock_qe_experiment_mcp_server.py, and scripts/aistock_qe_archive_mcp_server.py still define DEFAULT_BASE_URL values on 8011. If a client launches an MCP server without the env override, the MCP connects to the test port, violating the production MCP port policy. Fix all MCP default URLs to 8001 and add regression checks so registered/default MCP server URLs cannot point to 8011.
closure_requirements: All AIstock MCP production/client config entries keep loopback base URLs on 8001 and contain no 8011 test-port target.
All MCP server code default base URLs use 8001 so missing env overrides cannot fall back to 8011.
Add regression tests covering gateway defaults, QE MCP defaults, and repo MCP config port policy.
Run targeted MCP tests plus required issue workflow validation evidence.
Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
